<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="it"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
<title>TennisBot — Data Explorer (standalone)</title>
<style>
:root{--pcb-green:#0F3B2C;--pcb-deep:#0a2c20;--copper:#B87333;--solder:#C0C0C0;
--text-gold:#EAD0AC;--accent:#D98C53;--trace:#165B45;--gold:#FFD700;
--radius:0.5rem;--font:"Courier New",ui-monospace,monospace;
--shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.4);--ring:inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;height:100%}
body{font-family:var(--font);color:var(--text-gold);background:var(--pcb-green);display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100vh}
header{background:var(--pcb-deep);color:var(--text-gold);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:0 18px;height:58px;flex-shrink:0;border-bottom:2px solid var(--copper);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
header .logo{font-weight:700;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.5px;white-space:nowrap}header .logo b{color:var(--accent)}
header .search{flex:1;max-width:520px;display:flex}
header .search input{flex:1;background:var(--pcb-green);color:var(--text-gold);border:1.5px solid var(--copper);border-radius:var(--radius) 0 0 var(--radius);padding:8px 12px;font:13px var(--font)}
header .search input::placeholder{color:#9c8a6e}
header .search button{border:1.5px solid var(--copper);border-left:none;background:var(--accent);color:#1a1209;font-weight:700;padding:0 16px;border-radius:0 var(--radius) var(--radius) 0;cursor:pointer}
header .meta{margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;color:var(--copper);white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.5px}
.wrap{flex:1;display:flex;min-height:0}
aside{width:300px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--pcb-deep);border-right:2px solid var(--copper);overflow:auto;padding:8px 0;box-shadow:var(--ring)}
.src>summary{cursor:pointer;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--trace);letter-spacing:.5px}
.src>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.src>summary .chev{color:var(--copper)}
.sec>summary{cursor:pointer;padding:6px 14px 6px 26px;font-size:13px;color:var(--solder);list-style:none;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}
.sec>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.file{padding:6px 14px 6px 36px;font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;border-left:2px solid transparent;color:var(--text-gold)}
.file::before{content:"▪";color:var(--trace);margin-right:6px;margin-left:-14px}
.file:hover{background:var(--trace)}.file.active{background:var(--trace);border-left-color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.file.active::before{color:var(--gold)}
.file .badge{background:var(--copper);color:#1a1209;border-radius:10px;padding:1px 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
main{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:18px 22px}
.panel{background:var(--pcb-deep);border:1.5px solid var(--copper);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow),var(--ring);padding:16px 18px}
.crumbs{font-size:12px;color:var(--copper);margin-bottom:4px;letter-spacing:.5px}
.title{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);margin:0 0 2px}
.stat{display:inline-flex;gap:14px;margin:8px 0 14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stat span{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gold);background:var(--pcb-green);border:1px solid var(--trace);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:4px 10px}.stat b{color:var(--gold)}
.toolbar{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.toolbar input{background:var(--pcb-green);color:var(--text-gold);border:1.5px solid var(--copper);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:7px 10px;font:13px var(--font);min-width:220px}
.toolbar input::placeholder{color:#9c8a6e}
.tablebox{overflow:auto;border:1.5px solid var(--copper);border-radius:var(--radius);max-height:calc(100vh - 290px)}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:12.5px;white-space:nowrap}
thead th{position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--trace);color:var(--text-gold);text-align:left;padding:8px 10px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:2px solid var(--copper)}
thead th .arr{color:var(--gold);font-size:10px;margin-left:4px}
tbody td{padding:6px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(184,115,51,.2);color:var(--text-gold)}
tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:rgba(22,91,69,.25)}tbody tr:hover{background:var(--trace)}
.empty{color:var(--copper);text-align:center;padding:60px 0}.empty .big{font-size:15px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:6px}
.warn{color:var(--gold);font-size:12px}
@media(max-width:760px){aside{width:220px}}
</style></head><body>
<header><div class="logo">[ TennisBot ] <b>// DATA BUS</b></div>
<div class="search"><input id="gs" placeholder="grep file…"/><button>SCAN</button></div>
<div class="meta" id="hdrMeta"></div></header>
<div class="wrap"><aside id="nav"></aside>
<main><div class="panel" id="panel"><div class="empty"><div class="big">◇ SELECT A NODE ◇</div>
<div>Tutti i dati sono saldati dentro questo file — nessun server necessario.</div></div></div></main></div>

const SRC_LABELS={"tennis_db": "tennis-db.com", "tennis_explorer": "tennisexplorer.com", "tennis_abstract": "tennisabstract.com"};
let CURROWS=[],CURHEAD=[],sortCol=-1,sortDir=1;
function parseCSV(t){const rows=[];let f="",row=[],q=false;for(let i=0;i<t.length;i++){const c=t[i];
if(q){if(c=='"'){if(t[i+1]=='"'){f+='"';i++}else q=false}else f+=c}
else{if(c=='"')q=true;else if(c==','){row.push(f);f=""}else if(c=='\n'){row.push(f);rows.push(row);row=[];f=""}
else if(c=='\r'){}else f+=c}}if(f.length||row.length){row.push(f);rows.push(row)}
return rows.filter(r=>r.length>1||r[0]!=="")}
function nav(){const n=document.getElementById('nav');n.innerHTML='';let total=0;
for(const[src,secs]of Object.entries(MANIFEST)){const d=document.createElement('details');d.className='src';d.open=true;
d.innerHTML='<summary><span class="chev">▶</span>'+(SRC_LABELS[src]||src)+'</summary>';
for(const[sec,files]of Object.entries(secs)){const sd=document.createElement('details');sd.className='sec';sd.open=true;
sd.innerHTML='<summary>'+sec.replace(/_/g,' ')+' ('+files.length+')</summary>';
files.forEach(f=>{total++;const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='file';
el.dataset.s=(src+' '+sec+' '+f.name).toLowerCase();
el.innerHTML='<span>'+f.name+'</span><span class="badge">'+f.rows.toLocaleString()+'</span>';
el.onclick=()=>open(f,src,sec,el);sd.appendChild(el)});d.appendChild(sd)}n.appendChild(d)}
document.getElementById('hdrMeta').textContent=Object.keys(MANIFEST).length+' fonti · '+total+' file';}
function open(f,src,sec,el){document.querySelectorAll('.file.active').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));if(el)el.classList.add('active');
const rows=parseCSV(DATA[f.path]||'');CURHEAD=rows[0]||[];CURROWS=rows.slice(1);sortCol=-1;
const p=document.getElementById('panel');
p.innerHTML='<div class="crumbs">'+(SRC_LABELS[src]||src)+' › '+sec.replace(/_/g,' ')+'</div><h2 class="title">'+f.name+'</h2>'+
'<div class="stat"><span>Righe: <b>'+f.rows.toLocaleString()+'</b></span><span>Colonne: <b>'+CURHEAD.length+'</b></span><span>'+f.size_kb+' KB</span>'+
(f.truncated?'<span class="warn">⚠ troncato a 20.000 righe</span>':'')+'</div>'+
'<div class="toolbar"><input id="rs" placeholder="Filtra righe…" oninput="draw()"/></div>'+
'<div class="tablebox"><table><thead><tr id="thr"></tr></thead><tbody id="tb"></tbody></table></div>';
const thr=document.getElementById('thr');CURHEAD.forEach((h,i)=>{const th=document.createElement('th');
th.innerHTML=h+'<span class="arr" id="a'+i+'"></span>';th.onclick=()=>{sortDir=(sortCol===i)?-sortDir:1;sortCol=i;draw()};thr.appendChild(th)});draw()}
function draw(){const q=(document.getElementById('rs')?document.getElementById('rs').value:'').toLowerCase();
let d=CURROWS;if(q)d=d.filter(r=>r.some(c=>(c||'').toLowerCase().includes(q)));
if(sortCol>=0){d=[...d].sort((a,b)=>{const x=a[sortCol]||'',y=b[sortCol]||'';const nx=parseFloat(x),ny=parseFloat(y);
const bo=!isNaN(nx)&&!isNaN(ny);return(bo?(nx-ny):x.localeCompare(y))*sortDir})}
CURHEAD.forEach((_,i)=>{const a=document.getElementById('a'+i);if(a)a.textContent=(i===sortCol)?(sortDir>0?'▲':'▼'):''});
const cap=2000,sh=d.slice(0,cap);
document.getElementById('tb').innerHTML=sh.map(r=>'<tr>'+CURHEAD.map((_,i)=>'<td>'+(r[i]==null?'':String(r[i]).replace(/</g,'&lt;'))+'</td>').join('')+'</tr>').join('')
+(d.length>cap?'<tr><td colspan="'+CURHEAD.length+'" style="text-align:center;color:#565959">… '+cap.toLocaleString()+' di '+d.length.toLocaleString()+' righe (filtra)</td></tr>':'')}
document.getElementById('gs').addEventListener('input',e=>{const q=e.target.value.toLowerCase();
document.querySelectorAll('.file').forEach(el=>{el.style.display=el.dataset.s.includes(q)?'':'none'})});
nav();
</script></body></html>
